calls.head: Swayman isn’t cursed against the Jets
calls.body: Since 2023-24, Swayman has been shaky against the Jets, well below his usual. Fans love a pattern like this, but we checked three seasons of them and they predicted nothing. Expect the usual Swayman.
calls.call: If Swayman starts, his save percentage lands closer to his usual .908 than to his .877 against the Jets.
calls.nums: 5 starts against Winnipeg: .877 save percentage · .908 against everyone else
calls.cite: Goalie starts since 2023-24 · 5 against Winnipeg, 4,321 shots against everyone else
calls.happened: J. Swayman stopped 30 of 33 shots (.909), against his usual .908 and his .877 against this team before tonight.

calls.head: The Bruins roll four lines; the Jets lean on their top six
calls.body: The Bruins are one of the league’s best for depth, at the deep end; the Jets are one of the league’s worst, at the top-heavy end. Expect that gap to show.
calls.call: The Bruins spread their forward ice time deeper down the lineup than the Jets.
calls.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 1 and 0 games this season
calls.happened: On bottom-six share of forward ice time, Boston had 44% and Winnipeg 43%. Coming in, Boston was at 44% and Winnipeg at 40%.

WPG.head: We had this close to even (58% for Winnipeg), and it went Boston’s way.

BOS.head: We had this close to even (42% for Boston), and Boston came through.

surprises.head: Winnipeg’s power play came alive
surprises.body: Winnipeg’s power play created 19.2 expected goals per 60, against their usual 7.0 and a league average of 7.5. A team strays this far about once every 100 games.

surprises.head: Winnipeg tried a different line
surprises.body: G. Vilardi, I. Rosen, V. Björck played 9:15 together at 5-on-5, a trio that isn’t one of Winnipeg’s usual lines.

story.head: Peterka wins it in overtime
paras: Dylan DeMelo opened the scoring early in the first. Four different Bruins scored. The game was tied three times. JJ Peterka won it in overtime.

The chances were close to even, so this one could have gone either way. By our Swing measure, Kyle Connor had the best night of anyone, even in a loss. The Jets tried a line they hadn’t used before: Gabriel Vilardi, Isak Rosen and Viggo Björck.

items.text: Whether the Jets keep that line together in Detroit on Sunday.
One of the preview’s two calls held.
